title: Credit Builder Accounts Early-Closing Interest Share by Hardship Program
content:
The closing interest charged at an early closing of a Credit Builder account is reduced according to the program of the borrower's active Larkspur hardship plan. The plans are the borrower's Hardship Assistance Programs plans, read from the hardship plan records: each plan's status and program.

## Program shares

- When the borrower has a Larkspur hardship plan in active status under the Reduced Payment Plan or the Short-Term Payment Deferral, the closing interest is multiplied by the payment-relief share of 0.5.
- When the borrower has none of those but has a Larkspur hardship plan in active status under the Disaster Relief Deferral or the Term Extension Modification, the closing interest is multiplied by the other-relief share of 0.75.
- When the borrower has none of those four programs active, the closing interest is not reduced for hardship (a share of 1.0).

The share multiplies the closing interest before it is rounded to the cent.

| Active Hardship Assistance Programs plan held by the borrower | Share |
|---|---|
| Reduced Payment Plan, or Short-Term Payment Deferral | 0.5 |
| Disaster Relief Deferral, or Term Extension Modification, and neither of the two above | 0.75 |
| only other programs (such as a Temporary Rate Reduction Plan or a Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit), or no active plan | no reduction |

## Cases (hypothetical borrowers)

An unrounded closing interest of 8.00 becomes 4.00 for a borrower with an active Reduced Payment Plan, 6.00 for one whose only active plan is a Term Extension Modification, and stays 8.00 for one with an active Temporary Rate Reduction Plan alone. A borrower holding both an active Short-Term Payment Deferral and an active Disaster Relief Deferral takes 0.5.
